title: Iran Announces Hormuz Shipping Route Agreement With Oman, Barring US/Israel-Linked Vessels
detail: Iran said it reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, a potential step toward reopening the waterway to commercial traffic. Iran's deputy foreign minister said the framework does not automatically reopen the strait and would bar vessels linked to the US or Israel, requiring 'compensation' from hostile states before transit. The deal followed days of reported progress after Tehran and Muscat confirmed coordinates for new shipping routes on Aug 5-6. Washington was not a direct party to the agreement.

media.caption: Iran and Oman near a Strait of Hormuz shipping deal, but Washington remains at odds with Tehran's terms

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan Sign Mecca Joint Defense Pact Amid Iran War Spillover
detail: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif signed the 'Mecca Joint Deterrence Agreement' in Mecca, a NATO-style collective-defense pact stating that an armed attack on any of the three states will be treated as an attack on all. The pact comes amid repeated Iran-linked proxy attacks on Saudi territory during the war and pairs Turkey's large conventional military, Saudi Arabia's oil wealth, and Pakistan's nuclear arsenal. No official reaction was issued by Iranian leadership; an Iranian MP dismissed the pact as mere 'paper.'

media.caption: Erdoğan, Mohammed bin Salman and Sharif pose after signing the Mecca Joint Deterrence Agreement

title: Explosions Reported on Qeshm Island Near Hormuz After Reported Confrontation With 'Enemy Targets'
detail: Two explosions were reported on Iran's Qeshm Island following what Iranian state media described as a confrontation between Iranian armed forces and 'hostile enemy targets' near the Strait of Hormuz. However, Hormozgan province's deputy governor denied any strike had occurred on Qeshm Island or in provincial capital Bandar Abbas. Authorities said they were investigating the cause. No group has claimed responsibility and the incident remains unconfirmed.

media.caption: Explosions reported near Qeshm Island amid disputed reports of a strike

confidenceReason: Local Hormozgan officials denied any strike occurred; no attribution or casualty data confirmed by any party.
